crossRefs.note: For by this, the elders obtained testimony.
These all died in faith, not having received the promises, but having seen them and embraced them from afar, and having…
Turning to the disciples, he said privately, “Blessed are the eyes which see the things that you see,
for I tell you that many prophets and kings desired to see the things which you see, and didn’t see them, and to hear…
To them it was revealed, that they served not to themselves, but to you, in these things, which now have been announced…

translations.web: These all, having had testimony given to them through their faith, didn’t receive the promise,
translations.bsb: These were all commended for their faith, yet they did not receive what was promised.
translations.kjv: And these all, having obtained a good report through faith, received not the promise:
translations.asv: And these all, having had witness borne to them through their faith, received not the promise,
